title: Class-action waivers and arbitration
summary: A class waiver restricts the use of representative or aggregate proceedings, often through an agreement requiring individual arbitration. Its effect can depend on federal arbitration law and the applicable contract defenses.
notes: The casebook discussion includes disagreement over access and defenses. It does not justify treating every waiver as valid regardless of assent, scope, or the governing law.

sections.Meaning: A class waiver restricts the use of representative or aggregate proceedings, often through an agreement requiring individual arbitration. Its effect can depend on federal arbitration law and the applicable contract defenses.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the agreement, the proposed class procedure, the state rule invoked to invalidate the waiver, and the asserted federal conflict. Concepcion addresses the FAA and compelled class arbitration; the notes examine effects on small-value claims.
